title: Why Pirates Really Wore Eye Patches
description: Kleo engine check for the picture style: three shots per cinema scene, cut on the narration with `at`, one shot on the closing. The PNGs in img/ are flat 720x1280 placeholders; in production the worker downloads the generated picture of every shot as img/<sceneId>-s<n>.png and copies the first one onto scene.image for older tooling. Here scene.image is kept on the two cinema scenes only, which also proves the picture style ignores it and draws the shots.

scenes.title: eye patch
scenes.voice: Every pirate you have ever drawn wears an eye patch. But most of them still had both eyes. So what was the patch for?

scenes.title: night vision
scenes.voice: Below deck it is pitch black. Eyes need up to twenty five minutes to adapt to the dark. Keep one eye covered, and it is always ready. Lift the patch, and you can fight in the dark at once.

scenes.title: Try it tonight
scenes.voice: Try it tonight before you switch off the light. Then tell me if it worked.
